_comment: Known type errors in the generated web host, pinned so new ones fail CI (scripts/typecheck_ratchet.mjs).
The host is built by the production rjui codegen, so an error here is an error in every consumer's
@generated tree — and an @generated file cannot be patched downstream. The remaining errors have three
owners and are cleared independently; when the count reaches 0 the ratchet is replaced by a plain
`npm run typecheck` gate and this file is deleted.
Owners: (1) fixture layouts binding data they never declare (conformanceFire / conformanceMissing, 10) —
fixture authoring; (2) fixtureRegistry.tsx Record<string, unknown> conversions (26) — scripts/generate.mjs,
host scaffolding only, no consumer counterpart; (3) two strays: a fixture comparing distinct literal types
History: 89 before plan 37 (2026-08-04). TabView referencing an undeclared selectedTabIndex (48) and the
TextView onInput reading .value off an EventTarget (2) were codegen defects and are fixed; the Slider
double style attribute (1) went out with the plan 34 tint work.
